sections.heading: Pratham Khand - Jagrati, Swapn aur Sushupti ki Padtaal
blocks: Pichhle adhyay me humne Mahavakya sune. Unhone saadhak ko uske real swaroop ki taraf seedha sanket diya: Tattvamasi - tum vahi ho. Aham Brahmasmi - main Brahm hoon. Ayam Atma Brahma - yeh Atma Brahm hai. Prajnanam Brahma - Chetna hi Brahm hai. In vakyon ne saadhak ko body-mind ki limited pehchaan se aage dekhne ki disha di.

Ab hum ek bahut normal, lekin bahut gehri cheez ko dekhenge - avastha. Har din saadhak teen avasthaon se guzarta hai: jagrat, swapn aur sushupti. Hum jagte hain, kaam karte hain, raat me sapna dekhte hain, phir gehri neend me chale jaate hain. Subah uthkar phir wahi jeevan shuru ho jaata hai. Lekin Advaita poochta hai: in teenon avasthaon ko kaun jaanta hai?

Jagrat avastha abhi chal rahi hai. Tum yeh adhyay padh rahe ho. Body baithi ya leti ho sakti hai. Aankhen shabd dekh rahi hain. Mann meaning samajh raha hai. Bahar awaaz ho sakti hai. Body me sensations ho sakti hain. Koi thought uth sakta hai - “yeh samajh aa raha hai” ya “yeh subtle hai.” Yeh sab jagrat avastha me ho raha hai.

Jagrat me duniya solid lagti hai. Ghar, parivaar, kaam, log, body, time, space - sab real lagta hai. Experience karne wala “main” yahan bahut active hota hai. Woh kehta hai: “main kaam kar raha hoon”, “main successful hoon”, “main fail ho gaya”, “mujhe dukh hua”, “mere saath aisa hua.” Jagrat me ahankar aur anubhavkarta ko bahut material milta hai.

Pichhle adhyayon me humne dekha tha: body badalti hai, mann badalta hai, jagat Maya ke roop me experience hota hai, ahankar in sabko pakadkar “main” banata hai. Neti-neti kehti hai - yeh sab jaana ja raha hai, isliye yeh final main nahi hai. Ab jagrat avastha ko bhi isi drishti se dekho. Jagrat bhi experience me aati hai. Subah shuru hoti hai, din bhar chalti hai, raat me peeche hat jaati hai. Jo aata-jaata hai, woh final aadhaar nahi ho sakta.

Jagrat duniya stable lagti hai, lekin dhyan se dekho - jagrat experience bhi lagataar badal raha hai. Subah ka mann alag, dopahar ka alag, raat ka alag. Ek hi person kabhi pyara lagta hai, kabhi kathin. Ek hi body kabhi halki lagti hai, kabhi bhaari. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki jagrat life ka importance nahi hai. Vyavahar me body ki care, work, relation, compassion aur responsibility sab zaroori hai. Lekin saadhana poochti hai - kya jagrat avastha final satya hai?

Ab swapn avastha dekho. Raat me sapna aata hai. Sapne me ek poori duniya hoti hai. Log hote hain, jagah hoti hai, events hote hain, emotions hote hain. Sapne ke andar sab sach lagta hai. Agar sapne me koi chase kar raha hai, to fear real lagta hai. Agar sapne me koi pyara vyakti mil jaye, to happiness real lagti hai. Us waqt mann yeh nahi kehta - “yeh sapna hai.” Anubhavkarta sapne me bhi kehta hai: “main bhaag raha hoon”, “mujhe darr lag raha hai.”

Phir jagna hota hai. Jaagte hi sapne ki duniya ka status badal jaata hai. Jo abhi sach lag raha tha, woh sapne ki avastha tak seemit nikla. Ab sawal uthta hai: sapna kis me jaana gaya? Sapne ke baad hum kaise kehte hain - “mujhe sapna aaya”? Isse yeh samajh aati hai ki koi avastha apne andar bahut real lag sakti hai, lekin avastha badalte hi uski reality ki samajh badal sakti hai.

Ab teesri avastha hai sushupti - gehri neend. Isme na jagrat duniya hoti hai, na sapne ki duniya. Na body ka clear experience hota hai, na thoughts, na role, na kahani. Anubhavkarta ki normal activity shant ho jaati hai. Phir subah uthkar hum kehte hain - “achchi neend aayi” ya “mujhe kuch pata nahi tha.” Yeh bahut gehra vakya hai. Agar sach me kuch bhi nahi tha, to “kuch pata nahi tha” yeh kaise kaha gaya?

Sushupti ko moksha mat samjho. Deep sleep me rest hai, lekin clear self-knowledge nahi hai. Wahan avidya rehti hai, kyunki saadhak wahan jagruk roop se Atma ko nahi pehchanta. Phir bhi sushupti sanket deti hai ki body-mind activity rukne par bhi existence ka aadhaar khatam nahi hota.

Teenon avasthaon ko ek saath dekho. Jagrat aati hai. Swapn aata hai. Sushupti aati hai. Phir jagna hota hai aur tum kehte ho - “main soya tha”, “mujhe sapna aaya tha”, “ab main jaga hoon.” Avastha badalti hai, content badalta hai, lekin koi continuity hai. Yahi continuity kisi gehre aadhaar ki taraf sanket karti hai.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: raat ko sone se pehle kaho - “abhi jagrat avastha jaani ja rahi hai.” Agar subah sapna yaad aaye, dekho - “swapn avastha bhi jaani gayi.” Subah uthte hi kuch pal ruko - “gehri neend me ‘kuch pata nahi tha’ - yeh bhi ab jaana ja raha hai.” Phir poochho: “jagna aaya, sapna aaya, neend aayi - inke aane-jaane ko kaun jaanta hai?”

sections.heading: Dwitiya Khand - Turiya: Chauthi Avastha Nahi, Teenon ka Aadhaar
blocks: Pichhle khand me humne jagrat, swapn aur sushupti ko dekha. Jagrat me duniya solid lagti hai. Swapn me ek doosri duniya uthti hai. Sushupti me dono shant ho jaate hain. Teenon aati hain aur jaati hain. Phir bhi koi continuity hai jiske karan saadhak keh pata hai - “main jaga”, “mujhe sapna aaya”, “main soya tha.” Ab sawal hai: in teenon ka aadhaar kya hai?

Is course me Turiya ka arth hai - woh achal jagrukta jo jagrat, swapn aur sushupti teenon avasthaon ko jaanti hai, par khud kisi ek avastha me simit nahi hoti. Jagrat badalti hai. Swapn badalta hai. Sushupti bhi aati-jaati hai. Inke aane-jaane ki pehchaan kisi aadhaar par hi sambhav hai. Turiya usi aadhaar ki taraf sanket hai.

Turiya koi future me paane wali avastha nahi hai. Yeh koi special meditation experience nahi hai. Yeh koi light, bliss, silence ya emptiness ki event nahi hai. Jo aata hai aur jaata hai, woh avastha hai. Turiya woh hai jiske saamne avasthaen aati-jaati hain.

Kabhi kabhi language me Turiya ko “chauthi” kaha jaata hai, kyunki pehle hum teen avasthaon ki baat karte hain. Lekin asli samajh me Turiya koi chauthi aane-jaane wali avastha nahi hai. Yeh teenon ka aadhaar hai. Yeh teenon me maun roop se present hai. Yeh teenon se limited nahi hai.

Saadhak soch sakta hai ki Turiya koi bahut special experience hoga - meditation me mind ruk jayega, body ka pata nahi rahega, light fail jayegi. Aise experiences ho sakte hain. Unhe naakarna nahi hai. Lekin unhe Turiya mat samjho. Shanti aayi - jaani gayi. Anand aaya - jaana gaya. Khaali-pan aaya - jaana gaya. Deep state aayi - jaani gayi. Phir chali gayi - yeh bhi jaana gaya. Jo jaana gaya, woh experience hai. Turiya woh nahi ho sakta jo aata-jaata hai.

Ab jagrat me dekho. Words dikh rahe hain. Meaning samajh aa raha hai. Body sensations hain. Thoughts aa rahe hain. Sab jagrat me hai. Poochho - yeh sab kis me jaana ja raha hai? Words jaane ja rahe hain. Body jaani ja rahi hai. Thought jaana ja raha hai. Sound jaani ja rahi hai. Understanding aur confusion bhi jaane ja rahe hain. Knowing already present hai.

Turiya jagrat se door nahi hai. Jagrat experience usi me jaana ja raha hai. Lekin attention jagrat ki objects me kho jaata hai - body, work, relation, result, world. Jaise film me story dekhte hue screen bhool jaati hai. Screen chhupi nahi hoti, bas dhyan story me hota hai. Waisa hi jagrat me Turiya chhupa nahi hai; dhyan naam-roop me uljha hai.

Swapn me bhi experience hota hai. Sapne ki duniya, sapne ki body, sapne ka fear, sapne ki khushi - sab jaane jaate hain. Jagrit hone ke baad hum kehte hain - “mujhe sapna aaya.” Turiya sapne ka character nahi hai; sapne ka aadhaar hai. Jagrat aur swapn me content alag hai, par experience jaane ja rahe hain.

Sushupti sabse subtle hai. Deep sleep me na jagrat hai, na swapn, na active thought, na ordinary experiencer. Phir bhi existence break nahi hota. Uthkar kehte hain - “main soya tha”, “achchi neend aayi”, “kuch pata nahi tha.” Turiya sushupti ke andar koi experience nahi hai. Sushupti yeh sanket deti hai ki mind absent ho tab bhi aadhaar samaapt nahi hota.

Sakshi aur Turiya alag sach nahi hain. Sakshi ko pehle jagrat jeevan me pehchana jaata hai - “thought uth raha hai, main jaanta hoon.” Jab samajh gehri hoti hai, saadhak dekhta hai ki jagrat bhi jaani ja rahi hai, swapn bhi jaana gaya, sushupti ka abhav bhi baad me jaana gaya. Isi se Sakshi ki disha Turiya ki samajh me gehri hoti hai.

Turiya ko obtain nahi karna. Obtain woh hota hai jo abhi absent ho. Turiya absent nahi hai. Isi moment ka experience usi me jaana ja raha hai. Thoughts usi me uth rahe hain. Sakshi-bhav usi ki disha hai. Isliye Turiya ko paana nahi, pehchanna hai. Prapti future me hoti hai. Pehchaan abhi ho sakti hai.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: ek active work moment, ek imagination ya memory moment, aur ek shant ya khaali moment dekho. Har baar poochho: “yeh experience kis me jaana ja raha hai? Kya knowing presence experience ke saath badal rahi hai? Kya main kisi special state ko pakadna chahta hoon?” Smaran rakho: Turiya paane ki avastha nahi; Turiya woh aadhaar hai jisme avasthaen aati-jaati hain.

sections.heading: Tritiya Khand - Agyaeya/Agyaeta: Jise Object ki Tarah Nahi Jaana Ja Sakta
blocks: Turiya ko sunne ke baad mind naturally poochta hai: “Agar Turiya hai, to main use kaise jaanu?” Sawal sahi hai, lekin bahut subtle bhi hai. Mind jise jaan-na chahta hai, use object ki tarah jaan-na chahta hai. Mind chahta hai ki Turiya koi experience bankar saamne aaye - kuch aisa jo dekha ja sake, feel kiya ja sake, pakda ja sake, yaad rakha ja sake, aur kaha ja sake - “haan, maine Turiya jaan liya.”

Yahin sabse gehri saavdhani chahiye. Turiya koi known object nahi hai. Sakshi object nahi hai. Atma koi experience ki cheez nahi hai. Chetna koi aisi vastu nahi hai jise mind saamne rakhkar dekh sake. Kyun? Kyunki wahi sab jaanne ka aadhaar hai. Isi ko hum yahan agyaeya, ya agyeyata/agyaeta ki bhavna ke roop me samjhenge - jise mind object ki tarah nahi jaan sakta.

Hum normally cheezon ko kaise jaante hain? Aankh form dekhti hai. Kaan sound sunte hain. Skin touch jaanti hai. Mind thought samajhta hai. Buddhi meaning pakadti hai. Memory experience rakhti hai. Tab hum kehte hain - “maine yeh jaana.” Cup dekha, awaaz suni, thought samjha, emotion feel kiya. Yeh sab known objects hain.

Lekin Sakshi, Atma, Chetna ya Turiya aisi object nahi hai. Aankh use nahi dekh sakti, kyunki aankh ka dekhna bhi usi me jaana ja raha hai. Mind use thought ki tarah nahi pakad sakta, kyunki thoughts usi me uth rahe hain. Emotion use feel nahi kar sakta, kyunki emotion bhi usi me jaana ja raha hai. Experience use contain nahi kar sakta, kyunki experience usi me aata-jaata hai.

Aankh ka example lo. Aankh rang, shape, distance, light sab dekhti hai. Lekin aankh apni seeing ko seedhe object ki tarah nahi dekhti. Mirror me aankh ka reflection dikh sakta hai, lekin dekhne ki shakti object nahi banti. Isi tarah Chetna sabko jaanti hai, par khud object ki tarah saamne nahi aati. Jo saamne aata hai, woh known hai. Chetna woh hai jisme saamne aana bhi jaana jaata hai.

Ek aur example lo - diya. Raat me diya jalta hai aur room ki cheezen dikhata hai. Table, wall, book, person sab roshni se dikhte hain. Ab poochho: roshni ko kis roshni se dikhayenge? Light ko light banne ke liye doosri light ki zaroorat nahi. Isi tarah thoughts, emotions, body aur world ko jaanne ke liye Chetna hai. Lekin Chetna ko jaanne ke liye koi doosri Chetna nahi chahiye. Chetna swayam jaanne ka aadhaar hai.

Mind useful hai. Mind language samajhta hai, planning karta hai, doubts poochta hai, neti-neti me madad karta hai. Lekin final pehchaan mind ki pakad se pare hai. Mind known hai. Jo mind ko jaan raha hai, use mind object ki tarah kaise jaan lega?

Agyaeya ka matlab yeh nahi ki satya absent hai. Iska matlab hai - satya object ki tarah knowable nahi hai. Woh kisi form me nahi aata, sound ki tarah nahi sunai deta, emotion ki tarah nahi uthta, thought ki tarah nahi banta, state ki tarah nahi aata-jaata. Par woh sabse nikat hai, kyunki jo bhi aata-jaata hai, woh usi me jaana jaata hai.

Isse samjho: object ki tarah agyaeya, swaroop ke roop me self-evident. Jab tum kehte ho - “main hoon” - kya iske liye proof chahiye? Apne hone ke liye tumhe kisi aur praman ki zaroorat nahi. Thoughts baad me aate hain. Being ka basic bhaav pehle hai. Isi “main hoon” ki gehrai me, jab body-mind identity dheeli hoti hai, Atma ki disha khulti hai.

Experience karne wale ki ek final trick hai. Woh kehta hai - “mujhe Atma ka experience chahiye”, “mujhe Turiya ka experience chahiye”, “mujhe Brahm ka experience chahiye.” Yeh ichchha bhi jaani ja rahi hai. “Mujhe experience chahiye” kehne wala anubhavkarta hai. Jo bhi use milega, woh experience hoga. Aur experience aata-jaata hai. Isliye woh final satya nahi ho sakta.

Agyaeya ki samajh me “mujhe nahi pata” ki pavitrata hai. Mind ko usually “mujhe nahi pata” se darr lagta hai. Lekin saadhana me kabhi ek sacred moment aata hai jahan mind maantaa hai - “main ise object ki tarah nahi pakad sakta.” Yeh haar nahi hai. Yeh mind ki limit ko pehchanna hai. Jab mind jhukta hai, ek naya darwaza khulta hai.

Mahavakya bhi isi samajh se sune jaate hain. Tattvamasi, Aham Brahmasmi, Ayam Atma Brahma, Prajnanam Brahma - yeh mind ko koi object nahi de rahe. Yeh disha de rahe hain: body-mind se hato, anubhavkarta se hato, known cheezon se hato, aur knowing ke aadhaar ko pehchano. Vakya ko pakdo mat; vakya jis taraf point kar raha hai, wahan thahro.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: thought aaye, dekho - yeh jaana ja raha hai. Emotion aaye, dekho - yeh jaani ja rahi hai. Body sensation ho, dekho - yeh jaani ja rahi hai. Silence ho, dekho - yeh bhi jaana ja raha hai. “Mujhe jaan-na hai” ki ichchha aaye, dekho - yeh bhi jaani ja rahi hai. Phir poochho: “jo yeh sab jaan raha hai, kya use object ki tarah jaana ja sakta hai?” Answer mat banao. Bas knowing me thahro.

sections.heading: Chaturth Khand - Turiya ko Jeevan me Pehchanna aur Adhyay ka Samapan
blocks: Ab sawal hai: Turiya ki samajh ko jeevan me kaise jiya jaye? Kya Turiya sirf deep meditation me yaad rakhna hai? Kya iska matlab life se door ho jaana hai? Kya Turiya me rehne ka matlab hai ki mind, emotions aur world khatam ho jaayen? Nahi. Turiya ki sahi samajh life ko khatam nahi karti. Woh life ke aadhaar ko clear karti hai.

Jagrat life chalti rahegi. Dreams aayenge. Sleep aayegi. Relations rahenge. Work rahega. Emotions aayenge. Body badlegi. Mind chalega. Lekin saadhak dheere-dheere pehchanta hai ki in sabke peeche ek achal knowing presence hai, jo kisi ek avastha me limited nahi hai.

Sabse pehle jagrat jeevan me dekho. Din chal raha hai. Body kaam kar rahi hai. Mind soch raha hai. Duniya dikh rahi hai. Log mil rahe hain. Conversation ho rahi hai. Food, work, relation, responsibility - sab present hai. Normally saadhak in sab me kho jaata hai. Woh body ban jaata hai, mind ban jaata hai, role ban jaata hai, anubhavkarta ban jaata hai. Phir koi event aati hai aur woh kehta hai - “mere saath aisa hua.”

Turiya ki disha me saadhak dheere se dekhta hai: “Yeh jagrat avastha hai. Isme body experience ho rahi hai. Mind active hai. World dikh raha hai. Lekin yeh sab jaana ja raha hai.” Jagrat ko chhodna nahi hai. Sirf yeh pehchanna hai ki jagrat bhi ek known state hai.

Ordinary moments hi real doorway hain. Chai peete waqt taste jaana ja raha hai. Chalne waqt body movement jaani ja rahi hai. Kisi ne naam liya, reaction jaani ja rahi hai. Message aaya, mann ki movement jaani ja rahi hai. Praise aayi, happiness jaani ja rahi hai. Criticism aayi, contraction jaani ja rahi hai. Har moment Turiya ki disha me lautne ka darwaza hai.

Emotions aayenge - fear, sadness, anger, love, compassion, loneliness. Turiya emotions ko suppress nahi karata. Fear jaana ja raha hai. Sadness jaani ja rahi hai. Anger jaani ja rahi hai. Love bhi jaani ja rahi hai. Emotion aata hai, badalta hai, chala jaata hai. Knowing presence emotion ke aane-jaane se nahi badalti. Isse saadhak emotionless nahi hota; woh honest aur stable hota hai.

Relations me bhi Turiya useful hai. Koi apna harsh bolta hai, hurt uthti hai. Anubhavkarta kehta hai - “mujhe insult kiya gaya.” Ahankar kehta hai - “mujhe jawab dena chahiye.” Body tight hoti hai. Purani memories uthti hain. Agar saadhak thoda ruke, woh dekh sakta hai: words sune ja rahe hain, body react kar rahi hai, mind story bana raha hai, hurt uth rahi hai, yeh sab jaana ja raha hai. Reaction turant khatam ho, zaroori nahi. Lekin ek space banta hai.

Work me bhi yahi hai. Effort ho raha hai. Planning ho rahi hai. Result aayega - success ya failure. Success kehti hai - “main successful hoon.” Failure kehti hai - “main failure hoon.” Turiya ki disha me saadhak dekhta hai: work ka experience ho raha hai, effort ho raha hai, stress ya excitement jaani ja rahi hai, expectation uth rahi hai, yeh sab jagrat avastha ke andar jaana ja raha hai. Work chhoda nahi jaata; work zyada clear hota hai.

Saadhana me bhi Turiya samajhna zaroori hai. Kabhi meditation me shanti aayegi, kabhi nahi. Kabhi deep experience hoga, kabhi kuch special nahi. Anubhavkarta bolega - “aaj good practice hui”, “aaj kuch nahi hua.” Turiya ki disha me saadhak dekhta hai: shanti jaani ja rahi hai, ashanti jaani ja rahi hai, depth jaani ja rahi hai, “kuch nahi hua” ka thought bhi jaana ja raha hai. Saadhana experience collect karna nahi; experience ke aadhaar me lautna hai.

Deep sleep ko bhi sahi samjho. Sushupti me mind ki activity nahi hai, lekin clear self-knowledge bhi nahi hai. Wahan rest hai, par awakened recognition nahi. Turiya deep sleep nahi hai. Turiya unconsciousness nahi hai. Turiya experience ka absence nahi hai. Turiya jagrat, swapn aur sushupti teenon ka aadhaar hai.

Agyaeya ki baat yaad rakho. Turiya object nahi hai. Turiya experience nahi hai. Turiya ko mind pakad nahi sakta. Agar mind kahe - “maine Turiya pa liya”, use dekho. Agar ego kahe - “meri state high hai”, use dekho. Yeh sab known layers hain. Turiya claim nahi karta. Turiya maun aadhaar hai.

Turiya ki pehchaan ka phal hai lightness. Jo jagrat me heavy lagta tha, woh dheere-dheere halka hota hai. Emotions aati hain, par saadhak unme poora nahi doobta. Success aati hai, par ego kam phoolta hai. Failure aati hai, par identity poori nahi toot-ti. Dusra phal hai stability. Teesra phal hai karuna. Chautha phal hai simplicity - ab saadhak ko apni state prove karne ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.
Is adhyay ka saar: avasthaen badalti hain. Experiences aate-jaate hain. Mind kabhi active, kabhi silent hota hai. Par knowing ka aadhaar achal hai. Usi ki taraf Turiya sanket karta hai.

Ab antim adhyay “Moksha ki Jhalak” ki taraf yatra badhegi. Moksha koi door ki fantasy nahi. Moksha sirf death ke baad ki baat nahi. Moksha ka arth hai - bandhan ki jad par clarity, false identity ka dheela hona, Sakshi me sthirta, Maya ko samajhkar bhi compassion aur responsibility ke saath jeena.

Is hafte ke liye abhyas: din me teen baar avastha ko pehchano. Jab kaam ya world me busy ho, kaho - “jagrat avastha jaani ja rahi hai.” Jab mind memory, imagination ya worry me chala jaye, kaho - “mind apni chhoti swapn-duniya bana raha hai, yeh bhi jaana ja raha hai.” Jab shanti ya khaali-pan ho, kaho - “shanti ya khaali-pan bhi jaana ja raha hai.” Phir poochho - “jo yeh sab jaan raha hai, kya woh bhi avastha hai?” Answer mat banao. Bas thahro.

Subah shuru hoti hai, din bhar chalti hai, raat me peeche hat jaati hai. Jo aata-jaata hai, woh final aadhaar nahi ho sakta.

Jagrat duniya stable lagti hai, lekin dhyan se dekho - jagrat experience bhi lagataar badal raha hai. Subah ka mann alag, dopahar ka alag, raat ka alag. Ek hi person kabhi pyara lagta hai, kabhi kathin. Ek hi body kabhi halki lagti hai, kabhi bhaari. Iska matlab yeh nahi ki jagrat life ka importance nahi hai. Vyavahar me body ki care, work, relation, compassion aur responsibility sab zaroori hai. Lekin saadhana poochti hai - kya jagrat avastha final satya hai?

Ab swapn avastha dekho. Raat me sapna aata hai. Sapne me ek poori duniya hoti hai. Log hote hain, jagah hoti hai, events hote hain, emotions hote hain. Sapne ke andar sab sach lagta hai. Agar sapne me koi chase kar raha hai, to fear real lagta hai. Agar sapne me koi pyara vyakti mil jaye, to happiness real lagti hai. Us waqt mann yeh nahi kehta - “yeh sapna hai.” Anubhavkarta sapne me bhi kehta hai: “main bhaag raha hoon”, “mujhe darr lag raha hai.”

Phir jagna hota hai. Jaagte hi sapne ki duniya ka status badal jaata hai. Jo abhi sach lag raha tha, woh sapne ki avastha tak seemit nikla. Ab sawal uthta hai: sapna kis me jaana gaya? Sapne ke baad hum kaise kehte hain - “mujhe sapna aaya”? Isse yeh samajh aati hai ki koi avastha apne andar bahut real lag sakti hai, lekin avastha badalte hi uski reality ki samajh badal sakti hai.

Ab teesri avastha hai sushupti - gehri neend. Isme na jagrat duniya hoti hai, na sapne ki duniya. Na body ka clear experience hota hai, na thoughts, na role, na kahani. Anubhavkarta ki normal activity shant ho jaati hai. Phir subah uthkar hum kehte hain - “achchi neend aayi” ya “mujhe kuch pata nahi tha.” Yeh bahut gehra vakya hai. Agar sach me kuch bhi nahi tha, to “kuch pata nahi tha” yeh kaise kaha gaya?

Sushupti ko moksha mat samjho. Deep sleep me rest hai, lekin clear self-knowledge nahi hai. Wahan avidya rehti hai, kyunki saadhak wahan jagruk roop se Atma ko nahi pehchanta. Phir bhi sushupti sanket deti hai ki body-mind activity rukne par bhi existence ka aadhaar khatam nahi hota.

Teenon avasthaon ko ek saath dekho. Jagrat aati hai. Swapn aata hai. Sushupti aati hai. Phir jagna hota hai aur tum kehte ho - “main soya tha”, “mujhe sapna aaya tha”, “ab main jaga hoon.” Avastha badalti hai, content badalta hai, lekin koi continuity hai. Yahi continuity kisi gehre aadhaar ki taraf sanket karti hai.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: raat ko sone se pehle kaho - “abhi jagrat avastha jaani ja rahi hai.” Agar subah sapna yaad aaye, dekho - “swapn avastha bhi jaani gayi.” Subah uthte hi kuch pal ruko - “gehri neend me ‘kuch pata nahi tha’ - yeh bhi ab jaana ja raha hai.” Phir poochho: “jagna aaya, sapna aaya, neend aayi - inke aane-jaane ko kaun jaanta hai?”


### Dwitiya Khand - Turiya: Chauthi Avastha Nahi, Teenon ka Aadhaar

Pichhle khand me humne jagrat, swapn aur sushupti ko dekha. Jagrat me duniya solid lagti hai. Swapn me ek doosri duniya uthti hai. Sushupti me dono shant ho jaate hain. Teenon aati hain aur jaati hain. Phir bhi koi continuity hai jiske karan saadhak keh pata hai - “main jaga”, “mujhe sapna aaya”, “main soya tha.” Ab sawal hai: in teenon ka aadhaar kya hai?

Is course me Turiya ka arth hai - woh achal jagrukta jo jagrat, swapn aur sushupti teenon avasthaon ko jaanti hai, par khud kisi ek avastha me simit nahi hoti. Jagrat badalti hai. Swapn badalta hai. Sushupti bhi aati-jaati hai. Inke aane-jaane ki pehchaan kisi aadhaar par hi sambhav hai. Turiya usi aadhaar ki taraf sanket hai.

Turiya koi future me paane wali avastha nahi hai. Yeh koi special meditation experience nahi hai. Yeh koi light, bliss, silence ya emptiness ki event nahi hai. Jo aata hai aur jaata hai, woh avastha hai. Turiya woh hai jiske saamne avasthaen aati-jaati hain.

Kabhi kabhi language me Turiya ko “chauthi” kaha jaata hai, kyunki pehle hum teen avasthaon ki baat karte hain. Lekin asli samajh me Turiya koi chauthi aane-jaane wali avastha nahi hai. Yeh teenon ka aadhaar hai. Yeh teenon me maun roop se present hai. Yeh teenon se limited nahi hai.

Saadhak soch sakta hai ki Turiya koi bahut special experience hoga - meditation me mind ruk jayega, body ka pata nahi rahega, light fail jayegi. Aise experiences ho sakte hain. Unhe naakarna nahi hai. Lekin unhe Turiya mat samjho. Shanti aayi - jaani gayi. Anand aaya - jaana gaya. Khaali-pan aaya - jaana gaya. Deep state aayi - jaani gayi. Phir chali gayi - yeh bhi jaana gaya. Jo jaana gaya, woh experience hai. Turiya woh nahi ho sakta jo aata-jaata hai.

Ab jagrat me dekho. Words dikh rahe hain. Meaning samajh aa raha hai. Body sensations hain. Thoughts aa rahe hain. Sab jagrat me hai. Poochho - yeh sab kis me jaana ja raha hai? Words jaane ja rahe hain. Body jaani ja rahi hai. Thought jaana ja raha hai. Sound jaani ja rahi hai. Understanding aur confusion bhi jaane ja rahe hain. Knowing already present hai.

Turiya jagrat se door nahi hai. Jagrat experience usi me jaana ja raha hai. Lekin attention jagrat ki objects me kho jaata hai - body, work, relation, result, world. Jaise film me story dekhte hue screen bhool jaati hai. Screen chhupi nahi hoti, bas dhyan story me hota hai. Waisa hi jagrat me Turiya chhupa nahi hai; dhyan naam-roop me uljha hai.

Swapn me bhi experience hota hai. Sapne ki duniya, sapne ki body, sapne ka fear, sapne ki khushi - sab jaane jaate hain. Jagrit hone ke baad hum kehte hain - “mujhe sapna aaya.” Turiya sapne ka character nahi hai; sapne ka aadhaar hai. Jagrat aur swapn me content alag hai, par experience jaane ja rahe hain.

Sushupti sabse subtle hai. Deep sleep me na jagrat hai, na swapn, na active thought, na ordinary experiencer. Phir bhi existence break nahi hota. Uthkar kehte hain - “main soya tha”, “achchi neend aayi”, “kuch pata nahi tha.” Turiya sushupti ke andar koi experience nahi hai. Sushupti yeh sanket deti hai ki mind absent ho tab bhi aadhaar samaapt nahi hota.

Sakshi aur Turiya alag sach nahi hain. Sakshi ko pehle jagrat jeevan me pehchana jaata hai - “thought uth raha hai, main jaanta hoon.” Jab samajh gehri hoti hai, saadhak dekhta hai ki jagrat bhi jaani ja rahi hai, swapn bhi jaana gaya, sushupti ka abhav bhi baad me jaana gaya. Isi se Sakshi ki disha Turiya ki samajh me gehri hoti hai.

Turiya ko obtain nahi karna. Obtain woh hota hai jo abhi absent ho. Turiya absent nahi hai. Isi moment ka experience usi me jaana ja raha hai. Thoughts usi me uth rahe hain. Sakshi-bhav usi ki disha hai. Isliye Turiya ko paana nahi, pehchanna hai. Prapti future me hoti hai. Pehchaan abhi ho sakti hai.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: ek active work moment, ek imagination ya memory moment, aur ek shant ya khaali moment dekho. Har baar poochho: “yeh experience kis me jaana ja raha hai? Kya knowing presence experience ke saath badal rahi hai? Kya main kisi special state ko pakadna chahta hoon?” Smaran rakho: Turiya paane ki avastha nahi; Turiya woh aadhaar hai jisme avasthaen aati-jaati hain.


### Tritiya Khand - Agyaeya/Agyaeta: Jise Object ki Tarah Nahi Jaana Ja Sakta

Turiya ko sunne ke baad mind naturally poochta hai: “Agar Turiya hai, to main use kaise jaanu?” Sawal sahi hai, lekin bahut subtle bhi hai. Mind jise jaan-na chahta hai, use object ki tarah jaan-na chahta hai. Mind chahta hai ki Turiya koi experience bankar saamne aaye - kuch aisa jo dekha ja sake, feel kiya ja sake, pakda ja sake, yaad rakha ja sake, aur kaha ja sake - “haan, maine Turiya jaan liya.”

Yahin sabse gehri saavdhani chahiye. Turiya koi known object nahi hai. Sakshi object nahi hai. Atma koi experience ki cheez nahi hai. Chetna koi aisi vastu nahi hai jise mind saamne rakhkar dekh sake. Kyun? Kyunki wahi sab jaanne ka aadhaar hai. Isi ko hum yahan agyaeya, ya agyeyata/agyaeta ki bhavna ke roop me samjhenge - jise mind object ki tarah nahi jaan sakta.

Hum normally cheezon ko kaise jaante hain? Aankh form dekhti hai. Kaan sound sunte hain. Skin touch jaanti hai. Mind thought samajhta hai. Buddhi meaning pakadti hai. Memory experience rakhti hai. Tab hum kehte hain - “maine yeh jaana.” Cup dekha, awaaz suni, thought samjha, emotion feel kiya. Yeh sab known objects hain.

Lekin Sakshi, Atma, Chetna ya Turiya aisi object nahi hai. Aankh use nahi dekh sakti, kyunki aankh ka dekhna bhi usi me jaana ja raha hai. Mind use thought ki tarah nahi pakad sakta, kyunki thoughts usi me uth rahe hain. Emotion use feel nahi kar sakta, kyunki emotion bhi usi me jaana ja raha hai. Experience use contain nahi kar sakta, kyunki experience usi me aata-jaata hai.

Aankh ka example lo. Aankh rang, shape, distance, light sab dekhti hai. Lekin aankh apni seeing ko seedhe object ki tarah nahi dekhti. Mirror me aankh ka reflection dikh sakta hai, lekin dekhne ki shakti object nahi banti. Isi tarah Chetna sabko jaanti hai, par khud object ki tarah saamne nahi aati. Jo saamne aata hai, woh known hai. Chetna woh hai jisme saamne aana bhi jaana jaata hai.

Ek aur example lo - diya. Raat me diya jalta hai aur room ki cheezen dikhata hai. Table, wall, book, person sab roshni se dikhte hain. Ab poochho: roshni ko kis roshni se dikhayenge? Light ko light banne ke liye doosri light ki zaroorat nahi. Isi tarah thoughts, emotions, body aur world ko jaanne ke liye Chetna hai. Lekin Chetna ko jaanne ke liye koi doosri Chetna nahi chahiye. Chetna swayam jaanne ka aadhaar hai.

Mind useful hai. Mind language samajhta hai, planning karta hai, doubts poochta hai, neti-neti me madad karta hai. Lekin final pehchaan mind ki pakad se pare hai. Mind known hai. Jo mind ko jaan raha hai, use mind object ki tarah kaise jaan lega?

Agyaeya ka matlab yeh nahi ki satya absent hai. Iska matlab hai - satya object ki tarah knowable nahi hai. Woh kisi form me nahi aata, sound ki tarah nahi sunai deta, emotion ki tarah nahi uthta, thought ki tarah nahi banta, state ki tarah nahi aata-jaata. Par woh sabse nikat hai, kyunki jo bhi aata-jaata hai, woh usi me jaana jaata hai.

Isse samjho: object ki tarah agyaeya, swaroop ke roop me self-evident. Jab tum kehte ho - “main hoon” - kya iske liye proof chahiye? Apne hone ke liye tumhe kisi aur praman ki zaroorat nahi. Thoughts baad me aate hain. Being ka basic bhaav pehle hai. Isi “main hoon” ki gehrai me, jab body-mind identity dheeli hoti hai, Atma ki disha khulti hai.

Experience karne wale ki ek final trick hai. Woh kehta hai - “mujhe Atma ka experience chahiye”, “mujhe Turiya ka experience chahiye”, “mujhe Brahm ka experience chahiye.” Yeh ichchha bhi jaani ja rahi hai. “Mujhe experience chahiye” kehne wala anubhavkarta hai. Jo bhi use milega, woh experience hoga. Aur experience aata-jaata hai. Isliye woh final satya nahi ho sakta.

Agyaeya ki samajh me “mujhe nahi pata” ki pavitrata hai. Mind ko usually “mujhe nahi pata” se darr lagta hai. Lekin saadhana me kabhi ek sacred moment aata hai jahan mind maantaa hai - “main ise object ki tarah nahi pakad sakta.” Yeh haar nahi hai. Yeh mind ki limit ko pehchanna hai. Jab mind jhukta hai, ek naya darwaza khulta hai.

Mahavakya bhi isi samajh se sune jaate hain. Tattvamasi, Aham Brahmasmi, Ayam Atma Brahma, Prajnanam Brahma - yeh mind ko koi object nahi de rahe. Yeh disha de rahe hain: body-mind se hato, anubhavkarta se hato, known cheezon se hato, aur knowing ke aadhaar ko pehchano. Vakya ko pakdo mat; vakya jis taraf point kar raha hai, wahan thahro.

Aaj ke liye abhyas: thought aaye, dekho - yeh jaana ja raha hai. Emotion aaye, dekho - yeh jaani ja rahi hai. Body sensation ho, dekho - yeh jaani ja rahi hai. Silence ho, dekho - yeh bhi jaana ja raha hai. “Mujhe jaan-na hai” ki ichchha aaye, dekho - yeh bhi jaani ja rahi hai. Phir poochho: “jo yeh sab jaan raha hai, kya use object ki tarah jaana ja sakta hai?” Answer mat banao. Bas knowing me thahro.


### Chaturth Khand - Turiya ko Jeevan me Pehchanna aur Adhyay ka Samapan

Ab sawal hai: Turiya ki samajh ko jeevan me kaise jiya jaye? Kya Turiya sirf deep meditation me yaad rakhna hai? Kya iska matlab life se door ho jaana hai? Kya Turiya me rehne ka matlab hai ki mind, emotions aur world khatam ho jaayen? Nahi. Turiya ki sahi samajh life ko khatam nahi karti. Woh life ke aadhaar ko clear karti hai.

Jagrat life chalti rahegi. Dreams aayenge. Sleep aayegi. Relations rahenge. Work rahega. Emotions aayenge. Body badlegi. Mind chalega. Lekin saadhak dheere-dheere pehchanta hai ki in sabke peeche ek achal knowing presence hai, jo kisi ek avastha me limited nahi hai.

Sabse pehle jagrat jeevan me dekho. Din chal raha hai. Body kaam kar rahi hai. Mind soch raha hai. Duniya dikh rahi hai. Log mil rahe hain. Conversation ho rahi hai. Food, work, relation, responsibility - sab present hai. Normally saadhak in sab me kho jaata hai. Woh body ban jaata hai, mind ban jaata hai, role ban jaata hai, anubhavkarta ban jaata hai. Phir koi event aati hai aur woh kehta hai - “mere saath aisa hua.”

Turiya ki disha me saadhak dheere se dekhta hai: “Yeh jagrat avastha hai. Isme body experience ho rahi hai. Mind active hai. World dikh raha hai. Lekin yeh sab jaana ja raha hai.” Jagrat ko chhodna nahi hai. Sirf yeh pehchanna hai ki jagrat bhi ek known state hai.

Ordinary moments hi real doorway hain. Chai peete waqt taste jaana ja raha hai. Chalne waqt body movement jaani ja rahi hai. Kisi ne naam liya, reaction jaani ja rahi hai. Message aaya, mann ki movement jaani ja rahi hai. Praise aayi, happiness jaani ja rahi hai. Criticism aayi, contraction jaani ja rahi hai. Har moment Turiya ki disha me lautne ka darwaza hai.

Emotions aayenge - fear, sadness, anger, love, compassion, loneliness. Turiya emotions ko suppress nahi karata. Fear jaana ja raha hai. Sadness jaani ja rahi hai. Anger jaani ja rahi hai. Love bhi jaani ja rahi hai. Emotion aata hai, badalta hai, chala jaata hai. Knowing presence emotion ke aane-jaane se nahi badalti. Isse saadhak emotionless nahi hota; woh honest aur stable hota hai.

Relations me bhi Turiya useful hai. Koi apna harsh bolta hai, hurt uthti hai. Anubhavkarta kehta hai - “mujhe insult kiya gaya.” Ahankar kehta hai - “mujhe jawab dena chahiye.” Body tight hoti hai. Purani memories uthti hain. Agar saadhak thoda ruke, woh dekh sakta hai: words sune ja rahe hain, body react kar rahi hai, mind story bana raha hai, hurt uth rahi hai, yeh sab jaana ja raha hai. Reaction turant khatam ho, zaroori nahi. Lekin ek space banta hai.

Work me bhi yahi hai. Effort ho raha hai. Planning ho rahi hai. Result aayega - success ya failure. Success kehti hai - “main successful hoon.” Failure kehti hai - “main failure hoon.” Turiya ki disha me saadhak dekhta hai: work ka experience ho raha hai, effort ho raha hai, stress ya excitement jaani ja rahi hai, expectation uth rahi hai, yeh sab jagrat avastha ke andar jaana ja raha hai. Work chhoda nahi jaata; work zyada clear hota hai.

Saadhana me bhi Turiya samajhna zaroori hai. Kabhi meditation me shanti aayegi, kabhi nahi. Kabhi deep experience hoga, kabhi kuch special nahi. Anubhavkarta bolega - “aaj good practice hui”, “aaj kuch nahi hua.” Turiya ki disha me saadhak dekhta hai: shanti jaani ja rahi hai, ashanti jaani ja rahi hai, depth jaani ja rahi hai, “kuch nahi hua” ka thought bhi jaana ja raha hai. Saadhana experience collect karna nahi; experience ke aadhaar me lautna hai.

Deep sleep ko bhi sahi samjho. Sushupti me mind ki activity nahi hai, lekin clear self-knowledge bhi nahi hai. Wahan rest hai, par awakened recognition nahi. Turiya deep sleep nahi hai. Turiya unconsciousness nahi hai. Turiya experience ka absence nahi hai. Turiya jagrat, swapn aur sushupti teenon ka aadhaar hai.

Agyaeya ki baat yaad rakho. Turiya object nahi hai. Turiya experience nahi hai. Turiya ko mind pakad nahi sakta. Agar mind kahe - “maine Turiya pa liya”, use dekho. Agar ego kahe - “meri state high hai”, use dekho. Yeh sab known layers hain. Turiya claim nahi karta. Turiya maun aadhaar hai.

Turiya ki pehchaan ka phal hai lightness. Jo jagrat me heavy lagta tha, woh dheere-dheere halka hota hai. Emotions aati hain, par saadhak unme poora nahi doobta. Success aati hai, par ego kam phoolta hai. Failure aati hai, par identity poori nahi toot-ti. Dusra phal hai stability. Teesra phal hai karuna. Chautha phal hai simplicity - ab saadhak ko apni state prove karne ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.

Is adhyay ka saar: avasthaen badalti hain. Experiences aate-jaate hain. Mind kabhi active, kabhi silent hota hai. Par knowing ka aadhaar achal hai. Usi ki taraf Turiya sanket karta hai.

Ab antim adhyay “Moksha ki Jhalak” ki taraf yatra badhegi. Moksha koi door ki fantasy nahi. Moksha sirf death ke baad ki baat nahi. Moksha ka arth hai - bandhan ki jad par clarity, false identity ka dheela hona, Sakshi me sthirta, Maya ko samajhkar bhi compassion aur responsibility ke saath jeena.

Is hafte ke liye abhyas: din me teen baar avastha ko pehchano. Jab kaam ya world me busy ho, kaho - “jagrat avastha jaani ja rahi hai.” Jab mind memory, imagination ya worry me chala jaye, kaho - “mind apni chhoti swapn-duniya bana raha hai, yeh bhi jaana ja raha hai.” Jab shanti ya khaali-pan ho, kaho - “shanti ya khaali-pan bhi jaana ja raha hai.” Phir poochho - “jo yeh sab jaan raha hai, kya woh bhi avastha hai?” Answer mat banao. Bas thahro.
